cargo.name: Colonists (50)
cargo.desc: Fifty more colonists. Each fifty need a Colonist Lander.

cargo.name: Food
cargo.desc: Feeds the colony while the first AgriDome is built.

cargo.name: Life Support
cargo.desc: Keeps colonists breathing until a CHAP is built.

cargo.name: Colonist Lander
cargo.desc: Carries 50 colonists one way to the surface.

cargo.name: Cargo Lander
cargo.desc: Carries a cargo weight of 20 one way to the surface.

cargo.name: Seed Factory
cargo.desc: Power, robots, ore processing and temporary housing. Required.

cargo.name: Tokamak Reactor
cargo.desc: Covers most power needs on most worlds.

cargo.name: Solar Power Satellite
cargo.desc: Safe orbital power for worlds near their star. Needs receivers.

cargo.name: Solar Receiver Array
cargo.desc: Receives power from the Solar Power Satellite.

cargo.name: Geological Probe
cargo.desc: Shows mining sites and digging depth before landing.

cargo.name: Weather Satellite
cargo.desc: Warns of storms. Reduces storm damage.

cargo.name: Interstellar Probe
cargo.desc: Detailed data on every planet in the system.

cargo.name: Orbital Observer
cargo.desc: Keeps watch on the other colony.

cargo.name: ULBI Probe
cargo.desc: Specific data about the target system's planets.
